name: The Case of Pavlo Polubotok (1723) (C0018)

techniques.comment: The introduction of the collegium as a parallel organ of power to seize judicial and fiscal functions from the hetman's administration: it acted "as the highest appellate instance and administrative-controlling organ"(Citation: Енциклопедія історії України: Т. 6 2009), and "the Little Russian Collegium for the first time channeled Ukrainian finances into the tsar's treasury in full"(Citation: Енциклопедія історії України: Т. 6 2009).

The arrest of the acting hetman and officers in St. Petersburg for petitions defending autonomous rights. Peter was preparing a demonstrative reprisal: "Peter I planned to hold a show trial of Polubotok and his associates, accuse them of 'high treason,' and liquidate the Ukrainian autonomy. A special General Court was created for this purpose"(Citation: Смерть П. Полуботка в Петербурзі 2015). Only the prisoner's death derailed the plan: the hetman "died on December 21, 1724 (O.S.) of pneumonia"(Citation: Смерть П. Полуботка в Петербурзі 2015).
